title: A Language Goes Extinct Every 2 Weeks
hook: One language disappears every 2 weeks, taking a worldview with it.
closing: When a language disappears, knowledge no translation can fully replace goes too.
question: Which language should survive forever?

segments.say: About 4 in 10 languages are endangered, leaving their survival to the last fluent speakers.
Languages vanish about 6 times faster than last century—roughly one every 2 weeks.
Half of today's languages could disappear by 2100, erasing thousands of distinct worldviews.
